description: Artist profile by MBID: type, country, life span, gender, area with areaId, birth/formation and death/dissolution areas, IPI/ISNI identifiers, aliases, tags/genres, release-groups, band-membership / collaboration relationships, and external links. Chain areaId into musicbrainz_browse_entities link.area. Release-groups embed one upstream page (25); profile relationships are uncapped. Browse target_type=release-group with link.artist for the full discography. Set credits=release or credits=recording to page production, engineering and session credit relationships independently of the profile.

credit_types.description: With credits, match role names case-insensitively, separated by | (e.g. producer|engineer|mix). Omit for all roles.

credits.description: Opt in to relationship credits for this target entity type.

credits_limit.description: Maximum credit rows per page. Defaults to 25; maximum 100.

credits_offset.description: Zero-based credit offset after filtering. Defaults to 0 when credits are requested.

inc_relationships.description: Include band-membership / collaboration relationships and external links (url-rels).

inc_release_groups.description: Include the discography (release-groups). Capped at one page; use browse for the full set.

mbid.description: Artist MBID (hyphenated hexadecimal UUID; surrounding whitespace and uppercase accepted).

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (rejected before fetch), or MusicBrainz rejects it with HTTP 400. `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no artist exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). `invalid_credit_filter`: Credit filtering or paging is supplied without a credit mode, or credit_types contains an empty role. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
